name: 宠物营养补充剂
description: 辰荣贝康（ChenRongBeiKang）中式草本宠物营养补充剂系列：多种可饲用天然植物精心制备与浓缩，添加鸡肝粉、糊精与维生素制成的风味片剂，猫犬通用，共 7 款单品（见 product_lines）。

product_attributes.品牌: 辰荣贝康 ChenRongBeiKang（中式草本宠物护理专家）
product_attributes.产品名称: 宠物营养补充剂（PET NUTRITIONAL SUPPLEMENTS）
product_attributes.使用方式: 口服，按体重喂食，具体用量见各单品包装
product_attributes.保存: 密封，在凉暗干燥及清洁的环境中保存
product_attributes.资质: 本产品符合宠物饲料卫生规定（检验合格）
product_attributes.生产企业: 长沙东典药业有限公司
product_attributes.生产地址: 湖南省长沙市浏阳经济技术开发区康平路金阳智中心46栋、47栋
product_attributes.商标持有人: 张家界辰荣生物科技有限公司
product_attributes.通用注意事项: 本产品不得饲喂反刍动物

core_selling_points: 中式草本配方，多种可饲用天然植物精心制备与浓缩
0.4g 小片、鸡肝粉风味，可直接喂或碾碎拌粮
添加维生素A乙酸酯、维生素D₃、天然维生素E，保证值完整标示
猫犬通用，按体重计量喂食
配料表与成分保证值完整公开
符合宠物饲料卫生规定，检验合格，有正规生产许可证号
7 款单品分别针对不同日常营养关注点，按需选择
pain_points: 宠物挑食，补充剂喂不进去
不知道成分是否安全，不敢乱喂
换季、年龄增长、孕产前后想多一份日常营养呵护
补充剂品类多，不知道该选哪一款
target_audience: 家有中老年犬猫的主人
认可中式草本理念的养宠人群

palette: 单品包装主色（天蓝/草绿/薄荷青/橙色/玫红/雾灰/蓝紫）
visual_style.mood: 温和、治愈、草本自然、专业可信

compliance_rules: 宠物营养补充剂属于饲料，不是兽药，禁止宣称治疗、预防疾病或替代药物
功能表述只能使用包装上的定位语原句或“为××健康提供营养支持”句式；维生素A、D₃、E 可使用策划卡带列出的营养素功能声称标准句（原文照用，只放在成分屏）
不得出现疾病名称与症状，不得用画面暗示生病、打针、输液
草本原料可列出名称、展示外观品相、使用日常叫法，不得解释任何原料的药理功效或配伍
禁止使用“最”“第一”“100%有效”等绝对化与承诺性用语
妊娠期禁用的单品不得暗示孕期可用
宠物出镜需真实健康、不得展示虐待或强行喂食行为
video_scene_suggestions: 主人从包装盒里取出一片，宠物闻声凑过来
片剂放在掌心，猫咪低头舔食的微距
片剂碾碎拌进猫粮 / 狗粮，宠物埋头吃饭
7 色包装盒在木桌上依次排开的系列展示
阳光窗台下，宠物吃完舒服地趴着晒太阳
ambient_sound_library: 纸盒开盖的轻微摩擦声
片剂落在陶瓷食盆里的清脆“嗒嗒”声
猫咪咀嚼的咔嚓咔嚓声
狗狗欢快的短促叫声与爪子踩地板的哒哒声

product_lines.name: 猫静宝
product_lines.subtitle: 舒缓宁神片
product_lines.positioning: 为日常情绪健康提供关键支持
product_lines.usage_note: 本品将多种可饲用天然植物进行精心制备与浓缩，再添加鸡肝粉、糊精、维生素A乙酸酯等饲料添加剂，制成功能独特的风味片剂，适用于犬、猫，发情前期及发情期连续饲喂。
product_lines.dosage: 猫：口服，每天2片，连续饲喂。犬：口服，每5公斤体重1片/天，连续饲喂。
cautions: 本产品不得饲喂反刍动物

ingredient_visuals.name: 夜交藤
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 圆柱形段，直径 4~7mm、长 10~15mm；外皮紫红至紫褐，粗糙，有扭曲纵皱纹，节部略膨大；切面皮部紫红，木部黄白色、导管孔明显，中心有疏松的类白色髓
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: cylindrical cut sections of dried fleeceflower vine stem, 4-7 mm thick and 10-15 mm long, rough purplish-red to purple-brown bark with twisted lengthwise wrinkles; each cut end shows a thin purplish-red bark ring around yellowish-white porous wood and a small pale pith

ingredient_visuals.name: 酸枣仁
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 扁圆或扁椭圆形，长 5~9mm、宽 5~7mm、厚约 3mm；紫红至紫褐色，平滑有光泽，一面中央有一条隆起的纵线纹
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: flat oval seeds 5-9 mm long and about 3 mm thick, smooth glossy purplish-red to reddish-brown seed coat, one flat face with a single raised line down the middle

ingredient_visuals.name: 远志
ingredient_visuals.part: 根，抽去木心；中空的圆筒形段
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 细圆筒形段，直径 2~10mm、长 10~15mm，中间是空的；外表灰黄至灰棕，横皱纹密而深陷
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: short hollow tube-shaped pieces of dried root, 2-10 mm in diameter and 10-15 mm long, greyish-yellow to greyish-brown skin with dense deep crosswise wrinkles, the center empty where the woody core was removed

ingredient_visuals.name: 葛根
ingredient_visuals.part: 根；小方块或不规则厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 边长 5~12mm 的小方块或不规则厚片；切面浅黄棕至棕黄，纤维纹理明显；外皮淡棕，有纵皱
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: small rough cubes 5-12 mm across (or thick irregular slices) of dried kudzu root, light yellowish-brown cut faces with clearly visible coarse fibers, some edges with thin light-brown wrinkled skin

ingredient_visuals.name: 甘草
ingredient_visuals.part: 根和根茎；类圆形或椭圆形斜厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 斜切厚片，直径 6~35mm、厚 2~4mm；外皮红棕或灰棕，有纵皱；切面黄白，放射状纹理与形成层环明显
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: oval slanted slices of dried licorice root, 6-35 mm wide and 2-4 mm thick, a thin reddish-brown bark rim, pale yellow cut face with fine radiating lines and a visible ring

ingredient_visuals.name: 榧子
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 橄榄形或卵圆形，长 2~3.5cm、直径 1.3~2cm；壳薄而硬，灰黄或淡黄棕，有纵皱，一端钝圆、一端稍尖
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: olive-shaped whole seeds 20-35 mm long with a thin hard greyish-yellow to pale tan shell covered in fine lengthwise wrinkles, one end rounded and the other slightly pointed (not the dark roasted snack nut)

ingredient_visuals.name: 补骨脂
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 扁肾形小粒，长 3~5mm、宽 2~4mm、厚约 1.5mm；黑色至黑褐色，哑光，有细微网状皱纹
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: tiny flattened kidney-shaped fruits only 3-5 mm long, matte black to blackish-brown with a fine net-like wrinkled surface, piled like small dark grains

ingredient_visuals.name: 土茯苓
ingredient_visuals.part: 根茎；长圆形或不规则薄片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 大而薄的不规则片，厚 1~5mm，边缘不整齐；外皮黄棕或灰褐；切面类白至淡红棕，粉性，可见点状维管束与多数小亮点
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: large thin irregular slices 1-5 mm thick with ragged edges, a yellowish-brown to greyish-brown rim, and a powdery off-white to pale reddish-brown cut face dotted with tiny shiny specks (not white poria cubes)

ingredient_visuals.name: 诃子
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 卵形或长圆形整果，长 2~4cm、直径 2~2.5cm；黄棕至暗棕色，略有光泽，有 5~6 条纵棱，基部有圆形果梗痕
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: whole dried oval fruits 20-40 mm long, yellowish-brown to dark brown with a slight sheen and 5-6 distinct lengthwise ridges, a round stalk scar at the base

ingredient_visuals.name: 泽泻
ingredient_visuals.part: 块茎；圆形或椭圆形厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 圆或椭圆厚片，直径 2~6cm、厚 2~4mm；外圈淡黄至淡黄棕，有环状浅沟纹；切面黄白，粉性，有多数细孔
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: round to oval thick slices 20-60 mm across and 2-4 mm thick, a pale yellowish rim with faint ring grooves, a powdery off-white cut face scattered with many tiny pores

ingredient_visuals.name: 茯苓
ingredient_visuals.part: 菌核；去皮的方块或厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 去皮后的方块或厚片，大小不一；白色，偶带淡红或淡棕；断面颗粒状，没有纤维和纹理
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: plain chalk-white cubes and thick slabs of dried poria with a fine granular matte texture, no fibers, rings or grain lines, crisp cut edges

ingredient_visuals.name: 薏苡仁
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 宽卵形或长椭圆形粒，长 4~8mm、宽 3~6mm；乳白色，光滑，偶有黄褐色种皮残留；腹面有一条较宽较深的纵沟
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: plump milky-white oval grains 4-8 mm long, smooth and matte, each with one wide deep groove down one side, occasional tiny brownish skin remnants (larger and rounder than rice)

ingredient_visuals.name: 赤芍
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 类圆形片，直径 5~30mm、厚 2~4mm；外皮棕褐，粗糙；切面粉白或粉红，皮部窄，木部放射状纹理明显
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: round slices 5-30 mm across and 2-4 mm thick, a rough dark brown bark rim, pinkish-white to pale pink cut face with clear radiating lines

ingredient_visuals.name: 车前子
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 极小的扁椭圆粒，长约 2mm、宽约 1mm；黄棕至黑褐色，有细皱纹，一面有灰白色凹点状种脐
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: extremely tiny flat oval seeds about 2 mm long, yellowish-brown to dark brown, like fine dark sand when piled

ingredient_visuals.name: 山茱萸
ingredient_visuals.part: 去核果肉；不规则片状或囊状
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 皱缩的不规则片状或破囊状果肉，长 1~1.5cm、宽 0.5~1cm；紫红至紫黑色，有光泽，质柔软，没有果核
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: shriveled, torn, pitted pieces of dried cornelian cherry flesh 10-15 mm long, glossy purplish-red to purplish-black, soft and slightly sticky-looking, no whole round fruits and no pits

ingredient_visuals.name: 女贞子
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 卵形或肾形小果，长 6~8.5mm、直径 3.5~5.5mm；黑紫或灰黑色，皱缩不平；酒制品常附白色粉霜
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: small wrinkled oval dark berries 6-8.5 mm long, matte blackish-purple to greyish-black, some with a faint whitish bloom

ingredient_visuals.name: 枸杞子
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 纺锤形或椭圆形，长 6~20mm、直径 3~10mm；红色或暗红色，果皮皱缩，一端有白色果梗痕
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: dried goji berries, spindle-shaped, 6-20 mm long, red to deep red with slightly wrinkled skin and a tiny white stalk scar at one end

ingredient_visuals.name: 菟丝子
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 类球形小粒，直径 1~2mm；灰棕至棕褐色，粗糙，哑光
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: tiny round seeds only 1-2 mm across, matte greyish-brown and rough, looking like coarse sand in a pile

ingredient_visuals.name: 桑椹
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 长圆形聚合果，长 1~2cm、直径 5~8mm，由多数小瘦果聚成，表面颗粒感明显，带短果梗；黄棕、棕红至暗紫色
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: dried mulberries 10-20 mm long and 5-8 mm thick, elongated clusters of tiny bumps with a short stem, dark purple to reddish-brown, dull and slightly shriveled

ingredient_visuals.name: 泽兰
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 方柱形茎段，直径 2~6mm，四面有浅纵沟，黄绿或带紫色，节处紫色明显，有白色茸毛；切面中空；夹有带锯齿的碎叶
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: short cut segments of square four-sided stems 2-6 mm thick, yellowish-green tinged purple with distinctly purple nodes and fine white hairs, hollow centers, mixed with crumpled serrated leaf bits

ingredient_visuals.name: 厚朴
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 弯曲丝条或单、双卷筒，皮厚 2~7mm；外表面灰褐，粗糙，有椭圆形皮孔；内表面紫棕至深紫褐，较平滑，有油性
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: curled strips and rolled quills of thick dried bark 2-7 mm thick, rough grey-brown outer surface with oval lenticels, smooth oily purplish-brown inner surface

ingredient_visuals.name: 升麻
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 不规则厚片，厚 2~4mm，体轻；外缘黑褐或棕褐，粗糙，带坚硬须根残基；切面黄绿或淡黄白，有网状或放射状纹理与裂隙
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: irregular lightweight thick slices 2-4 mm thick with a rough blackish-brown rim and stiff rootlet stubs, the cut face yellowish-green to pale yellow with a net-like or radiating pattern and small cracks (Chinese bugbane, not North American black cohosh)

ingredient_visuals.name: 银杏叶
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 扇形叶，宽 5~15cm，上缘波状、常有凹缺；干后黄绿或浅棕黄，二叉状平行细脉从叶基放射，没有中脉；多皱折、破碎
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: dried fan-shaped ginkgo leaves 5-15 cm wide with a wavy, often notched top edge, fine parallel veins fanning out from the stalk and no midrib, dull yellowish-green to pale tan, slightly crumpled (not fresh bright green, not glowing autumn gold)

ingredient_visuals.name: 薤白
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 不规则卵圆形小鳞茎，高 0.5~1.5cm、直径 0.5~1.8cm；黄白至淡黄棕，皱缩，半透明，有类白色膜质鳞片，底部有突起的鳞茎盘
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: small wrinkled dried bulbs 5-18 mm across, translucent waxy yellowish-white to pale tan, some with papery whitish skins and a raised root disc at the base, like tiny shriveled shallots

ingredient_visuals.name: 茜草
ingredient_visuals.botanical: Rubiae Radix et Rhizoma（Indian madder root）
ingredient_visuals.part: 根和根茎；细段或小厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 细根小段，直径 2~10mm；外皮红棕或暗棕，有细纵纹；切面皮部紫红，木部浅黄红，密布小孔
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: thin short segments of dried madder root only 2-10 mm thick, reddish-brown to dark brown skin, the cut ends purplish-red and finely porous

ingredient_visuals.name: 黄精
ingredient_visuals.part: 根茎；不规则厚片，市售多为酒制黑片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 不规则厚片；切面略呈角质样，淡黄至黄棕，可见多数淡黄色筋脉小点；酒黄精通体棕褐至黑色，油润有光泽，质柔软
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: irregular thick slices with a slightly translucent horn-like cut face, pale yellow to yellowish-brown with many small vein dots; the wine-steamed kind is glossy blackish-brown, soft and sticky-looking

ingredient_visuals.name: 沙棘
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 类球形小果，直径 5~8mm；橙黄或棕红色，皱缩，常数个粘连成团，顶端有残存花柱
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: small shriveled round dried berries 5-8 mm across, orange-yellow to brownish-red, often stuck together in little clumps (not plump glossy fresh berries)

ingredient_visuals.name: 党参
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 类圆形厚片或段，直径 4~20mm；外皮灰黄至灰棕，有纵皱与横长皮孔样突起；切面皮部淡棕黄，木部淡黄，有裂隙或放射状纹理；略带韧性
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: round thick slices or short segments of dried codonopsis root 4-20 mm thick, greyish-yellow wrinkled skin, the cut face pale yellow with a light-brown outer ring, small cracks and radiating lines, slightly leathery

ingredient_visuals.name: 益母草
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 方茎切段，长约 2cm，茎直径 2~5mm，四面凹下成纵沟，灰绿或黄绿；切面中部有白色实心髓；夹有皱缩破碎的灰绿色叶片
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: cut segments about 20 mm long of square four-sided stems 2-5 mm thick with grooved sides, greyish-green to yellowish-green, each cut end showing a solid white pith, mixed with crumpled grey-green leaf fragments

ingredient_visuals.name: 白术
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 较大的不规则厚片；外皮灰黄或灰棕；切面黄白至淡棕，散生稀疏的棕黄色点状油室，可见放射状纹理
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: large irregular thick slices with a greyish-yellow knobby rim, off-white to light tan cut face sprinkled with sparse brownish-yellow oil dots and faint radiating lines

ingredient_visuals.name: 桑枝
ingredient_visuals.part: 嫩枝；类圆形或椭圆形斜厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 斜切厚片，直径 5~15mm、厚 2~5mm；外皮薄，灰黄或黄褐，有点状皮孔；切面木部黄白，有放射线，中心有小白髓
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: small oval slanted slices of mulberry twig 5-15 mm across and 2-5 mm thick, thin greyish-yellow bark with dot-like lenticels, pale yellowish-white wood with fine radiating rays and a tiny white pith

ingredient_visuals.name: 野菊花
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 类球形小花头，直径 3~10mm，棕黄色；外围一轮皱缩卷曲的黄色舌状花，中央多数深黄色管状花，底部有灰绿色苞片
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: tiny dried wild chrysanthemum heads only 3-10 mm across, roughly pea-sized balls, one ring of curled yellow petals around a dense deep-yellow center, greyish-green bracts underneath, slightly brownish-yellow overall

ingredient_visuals.name: 蒲公英
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 皱缩破碎的段：棕褐色根段、绿褐或暗灰绿色羽状裂叶碎片，偶见黄褐色花头与带白色冠毛的瘦果
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: a loose mix of crumpled cut pieces of dried dandelion: brown wrinkled root bits, dark greyish-green fragments of deeply lobed leaves, and occasional brownish-yellow flower heads with white fluffy seeds

ingredient_visuals.name: 金银花
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 细棒状花蕾，上粗下细，略弯曲，长 2~3cm，上部直径约 3mm；黄白或绿白色，密被短柔毛
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: dried unopened honeysuckle buds, slender slightly curved club shapes 20-30 mm long and about 3 mm thick at the top, creamy yellow-white to pale greenish-white with fine fuzzy hairs (closed buds, not open flowers)

ingredient_visuals.name: 桔梗
ingredient_visuals.part: 根，多已去皮；椭圆形或不规则厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 去皮后的白净厚片，直径 7~20mm；切面皮部黄白、较窄，有一圈明显的棕色形成层环，木部较宽，有较多裂隙
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: clean peeled oval slices 7-20 mm across, creamy white cut face with one distinct thin brown ring and many small radial cracks, almost no bark

ingredient_visuals.name: 金荞麦
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 不规则厚片，直径 1~4cm，质坚硬；外皮棕褐；切面淡黄白或淡棕红，有放射状纹理，有的中央髓部颜色较深
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: hard irregular thick slices 10-40 mm across with a dark brown rim, the cut face pale yellowish to pale reddish-brown with radiating lines and a darker center

ingredient_visuals.name: 鱼腥草
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 扁圆柱形、扭曲的茎段，淡红棕至黄棕，有纵棱（药典记载鲜品茎直径 2.5~4.5mm，干品更细）；夹有黄棕至暗棕色、皱缩破碎的心形叶片与穗状花序
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: cut segments of flattened ridged stems 2-4 mm thick, reddish-brown to yellowish-brown, mixed with crumpled brown fragments of heart-shaped leaves and small spike flower clusters

ingredient_visuals.name: 知母
ingredient_visuals.part: 根茎；不规则类圆形厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 小类圆形厚片，直径 8~15mm；外缘黄棕，常残留黄棕色毛须状叶基纤维；切面黄白至黄色
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: small roundish thick slices 8-15 mm across, pale yellow to off-white cut face, the brownish rim fringed with fine yellowish-brown hair-like fibers

ingredient_visuals.name: 地骨皮
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 薄卷筒状或槽状根皮，长 3~10cm、宽 0.5~1.5cm、厚 1~3mm；外表面灰黄至棕黄，粗糙，易成鳞片状剥落；内表面黄白至灰黄
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: thin curled quills and troughs of root bark 30-100 mm long, 5-15 mm wide and 1-3 mm thick, rough greyish-yellow outer surface flaking off in scales, smooth pale yellowish inner surface

ingredient_visuals.name: 杜仲
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 厚 3~7mm 的树皮块或丝；外表面淡棕或灰褐，有皱纹或纵裂槽纹；内表面暗紫色，光滑；折断处有细密、银白色、富弹性的橡胶丝相连
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: flat pieces of thick dried bark 3-7 mm thick, rough light-brown to grey-brown outer surface with furrows, smooth dark purplish inner surface; where a piece is snapped, fine silvery-white elastic latex threads stretch between the halves

ingredient_visuals.name: 苍术
ingredient_visuals.part: 根茎；不规则类圆形或条形厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 类圆形或条形厚片，直径 1~4cm；外皮灰棕至黑棕；切面黄白或灰白，散有多数橙黄至棕红色油点，有的析出白色细针状结晶（起霜）
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: irregular thick slices 10-40 mm across with a grey-brown to blackish rim, off-white cut face densely speckled with orange-red oil dots, some showing a faint white crystalline frost

ingredient_visuals.name: 木香
ingredient_visuals.part: 根；类圆形或不规则厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 类圆形厚片，直径 5~50mm；外皮黄棕至灰褐；切面棕黄至棕褐，中部有菊花心状放射纹理，形成层环棕色，散有褐色油点
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: round thick slices 5-50 mm across, yellowish-brown to brown cut face with a chrysanthemum-like radiating pattern in the center, a darker brown ring and scattered brown oil dots

ingredient_visuals.name: 姜黄
ingredient_visuals.part: 根茎；不规则或类圆形厚片
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 厚片，直径 1~3cm；外皮深黄；切面棕黄至金黄，角质样，有蜡样光泽，内皮层环纹明显，维管束点状散在
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: round to irregular thick slices 10-30 mm across, deep golden-yellow to orange-brown waxy horn-like cut face with a clear inner ring and scattered dots, deep yellow skin

ingredient_visuals.name: 川芎
ingredient_visuals.appearance: 形状不规则、边缘起伏的厚片（习称蝴蝶片）；外皮灰褐；切面黄白或灰黄，有明显的波状环纹或多角形纹理，散生黄棕色油点
ingredient_visuals.prompt_en: irregular thick slices with wavy lobed outlines like butterfly wings, grey-brown rim, off-white to greyish-yellow cut face with a distinct wavy ring pattern and scattered yellowish-brown oil dots
